subject: Coord: SOC 2 / DPA / pen-test walkthrough — evening fallback and preflight packet
messages:
From: Claudia Mendez <claudia.mendez@starboard.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: starboard-security@starboard.com
Date: Mon, 20 Nov 2028 09:14:00 -0500
Subject: Request: SOC 2 + DPA review + pen-test scoping walkthrough

Hi Sergio,

Thanks for taking this — we'd like to book a combined session to: 1) run through our SOC 2 readiness questions, 2) walk the DPA draft, and 3) scope a forthcoming penetration test. We usually do a 60–90 minute kickoff so all teams (security, legal, infra) can align.

Proposed windows (ET):
- Tue Nov 28 14:00–15:30 ET
- Wed Nov 29 09:00–10:30 ET

If neither works we can do an evening slot after 17:00 ET on Tue Nov 28. Please confirm who from Redwood should join (engineers, SRE, legal) so we can invite the right folks.

I attached our preliminary controls export and a short list of security requirements to speed the preflight. We'll share the pen-test vendor contact separately once scope is agreed.

Attachments: starboard_prelim_controls.pdf (summary), security-reqs.xlsx

— Claudia
Claudia Mendez
Head of Security, Starboard Finance
claudia.mendez@starboard.com
+1 415-555-0123

From: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Claudia Mendez <claudia.mendez@starboard.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 20 Nov 2028 11:02:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 + DPA review + pen-test scoping walkthrough

Thanks Claudia — appreciate the docs.

On Mon, Nov 20, 2028 at 9:14 AM Claudia Mendez <claudia.mendez@starboard.com> wrote:
> Thanks for taking this — we'd like to book a combined session...

We can take either of the proposed windows but I'll flag an evening fallback for our EMEA/ops folks in case you need after 17:00 ET. New proposed fallback: Tue Nov 28 17:00–18:30 ET (60–90 min).

Who from Starboard will attend? Also helpful: a short list of the high-priority controls you want us to cover (authn, data retention, logging, incident playbook). If you have any doc links (Confluence/Drive) we can pre-read.

I'll plan to include Laura Bennett (CS ops lead) and rotate in engineers depending on the agenda — typically Ben Carter (SRE) and Marissa Cole (platform). If you confirm the 17:00 fallback I'll ask Laura to lock an evening bridge.

Best,
Sergio
Sergio Alvarez
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
sergio.alvarez@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Claudia Mendez <claudia.mendez@starboard.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Nov 2028 13:45:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 + DPA review + pen-test scoping walkthrough

Sergio — copying the team availability so Claudia can pick a firm slot.

Available from our side:
- Ben Carter (SRE) — Tue Nov 28 14:00–16:00 ET or 17:00–19:00 ET
- Marissa Cole (Platform) — Tue Nov 28 16:00–19:00 ET (prefers later)
- Laura Bennett (CS ops) — flexible, can host bridge at either fallback

If Claudia confirms the 17:00 fallback we'll do a 75-minute session: 45 min walkthrough (controls + DPA highlights) + 30 min pen-test scoping Q&A.

I attached a draft of the internal preflight checklist we use for combined sessions — it's short and helps narrow the agenda.

Attachments: internal_preflight_checklist.pdf

— Laura
Laura Bennett
CS Operations, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Claudia Mendez <claudia.mendez@starboard.com>
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: starboard-security@starboard.com
Date: Mon, 20 Nov 2028 16:53:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Request: SOC 2 + DPA review + pen-test scoping walkthrough

Perfect — let's take the evening fallback. Please hold Tue Nov 28 17:00–18:15 ET (we trimmed to 75 minutes).

Attendees from Starboard: Claudia Mendez (security), Daniel Park (legal), starboard-security@starboard.com. We'll send a calendar invite and include a short agenda: intro (10m), SOC 2 controls deep-dive (30m), DPA redline highlights (20m), pen-test scope Q&A (15m).

I uploaded the DPA draft and attached a DocuSign stub for a confidentiality checklist — please review before the call. Pen-test vendor: securetest-ops@securetest.com (we'll loop them into follow-ups).

Calendar: https://calendar.google.com/event?eid=starboard-redwood-walkthrough
Docusign (DPA draft): https://docusign.com/some-doc-id-STAR-321

Attachments: DPA-Starboard-Redwood-draft.docx

Thanks — Claudia
